scope: ArchiveBox archival lifecycle, snapshot metadata, and repeatability; no new Gladeye crawl yet

official_runtime.supported_method: Docker/WSL2 for Windows, not native Windows
official_runtime.attempt: Docker Desktop started, but engine info command stopped when free RAM reached 248 MiB. Desktop stop and WSL shutdown exited 0.

isolated_native_trial.reason: POSIX-only module import unsupported by native Windows

next_action: Resume with official GHCR container only after host RAM headroom increases without interrupting unsaved user work; run one scoped actual ArchiveBox capture then compare new archived content/hash/metadata vs X01–X10. Do not spoof the POSIX pwd API on Windows, alter system security, or label X11 PASS.

second_official_attempt.method: Original pinned official GHCR Docker image; no new paid runtime; one bounded preflight; no image pull after insufficient headroom

ram_optimization_review.evidence: Docker startup and Engine accounted for large observed host headroom drop; host free memory changed 1948 to 137 MiB. This is a before/after observation, not an exact process-attributable RAM footprint.
ram_optimization_review.official_minimum: ArchiveBox official wiki says 500 MiB bare minimum for lighter use, 2 GiB recommended, with Chrome-based extractors disabled to reduce capture load; these figures exclude Docker Desktop/WSL/Windows overhead.

candidate_options.name: Host headroom first
candidate_options.proposal: Before any retry, end or suspend only user-approved idle RAM-intensive desktop apps, preserving VPN/remote connector and any unsaved work; aim for at least ~2.5-3 GiB Windows available RAM before starting Docker (planning target, not guaranteed minimum).

candidate_options.name: Bound WSL VM
candidate_options.proposal: Evaluate reversible 2048MB -> 1536MB WSL memory cap with 4GB swap preserved; may free up to ~512 MiB host headroom but reduces Linux memory under ArchiveBox suggested 2 GiB and may prevent container launch; do not apply without review.
candidate_options.result: Actual 1536MB test hit 96MiB emergency guard; 70MiB minimum during cleanup; restored 2048MB with SHA256 verification

candidate_options.name: Keep serial pulls
candidate_options.proposal: Docker daemon max-concurrent-downloads=1 already verified. No gain from setting it to 1 again. Avoid concurrent containers/pulls.

candidate_options.name: Metadata-only first
candidate_options.proposal: Once container runs, disable CHROME_ENABLED, SCREENSHOT_ENABLED, PDF_ENABLED, MEDIA_ENABLED, SINGLEFILE_ENABLED and ARCHIVEDOTORG_ENABLED during first scoped ArchiveBox proof. Avoid multi-process server/worker stack if CLI suffices.

candidate_options.name: Per-container budget
candidate_options.proposal: For a future one-off CLI, consider memory=1024m, memory-swap=1536m, cpus=1.5, small /dev/shm with Chrome disabled; Docker container caps do not reduce Docker Desktop startup cost.

candidate_options.name: Alternative runtime
candidate_options.proposal: Do not install another host agent or move private archives to external cloud without a separate assessment and owner approval. Native Windows ArchiveBox remains blocked on POSIX pwd.

wsl_1536_mib_owner_approved_test.goal: One reversible official ArchiveBox Docker/WSL 1536MB experiment with 100MiB Windows-free-RAM guard
wsl_1536_mib_owner_approved_test.docker_engine_info_failed_reason: RAM guard activated before engine query completed
wsl_1536_mib_owner_approved_test.risk_note: 100 MiB emergency free-RAM is best-effort and was violated due to asynchronous OS/WSL shutdown. Do not claim a hard protected floor.
wsl_1536_mib_owner_approved_test.next: Do not auto-retry WSL reduction or launch further Docker steps. Re-evaluate reducing host application footprint with explicit user coordination, choose lower-overhead supported Linux runtime only after cost/security assessment, or record X11 as blocked with evidence and proceed only under authorized runbook gate.
